```sql
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN customer.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.CustomerID
WHERE DATE(t.Date) = '2012-08-25' AND t.Amount IS NOT NULL;
```
